Name: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
Description: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals is an entry-level certification designed to introduce individuals to the core concepts and services of Microsoft Azure, focusing on cloud computing, Azure architecture, and basic management tools. It provides foundational knowledge for deploying, managing, and securing applications in the Azure cloud environment.

Name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
Description: Validates the ability to design and deploy scalable, highly available systems on AWS, with an emphasis on cost-optimization and security.

Name: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
Description: Recognizes foundational skills in networking, including IP connectivity, security fundamentals, automation, and programmability.

Name: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
Description: Introduces the principles and practices of Agile and Scrum, including facilitating teamwork, removing impediments, and supporting product owners.
Jobs Related: Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Product Owner

Name: CompTIA Security+
Description: Covers essential principles for securing networks and managing risk, including threats, vulnerabilities, cryptography, and identity management.

Name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
Description: Teaches skills in data collection, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision making with Google tools.

Name: PMP (Project Management Professional)
Description: Demonstrates knowledge and skills in leading and directing projects, including planning, budgeting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.

Name: Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE Programmer
Description: Validates proficiency in Java programming, including syntax, object-oriented principles, and performance tuning.

Name: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
Description: Focuses on information systems auditing, control, assurance, and security best practices.

Name: Adobe Certified Professional – Photoshop
Description: Certifies essential Photoshop skills in image editing, compositing, and design for digital and print projects.
